title: Mossvale Village Tasks
description: Villagers' tasks and each hero's completed tasks. Vale owns the villager and player rows; this app owns only the tasks and completions.

village_task.description: A task offered by a villager in Vale. The villager field is that villager's stable Vale eid.

village_done.description: One hero's completion of one village task. Vale reads this to choose what that hero hears; it remains the authority for the hero and villager.
